tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Raptors at 76ers. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! Poeltl versus Embiid for the tip, and Poeltl has owned that matchup in the circle! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Raptors to cash the first trip! Murray-Boyles is the sneaky finisher on that opening trip!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Here comes Pistons at Wizards, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Davis and Collins meet in the circle, and Davis has been winning these jumps all season long! That puts the Wizards on the front foot to get on the board first. If Davis wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look! If the Pistons get there first, Collins is who we want firing!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Here comes Pistons at Wizards, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Davis and Collins meet in the circle, and Davis has been winning these jumps all season long! That puts the Wizards on the front foot to get on the board first. If Davis wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look! tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Mavericks at Timberwolves, because the first minute is where the money is! Gafford has to deal with Gobert in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! That hands the Timberwolves the first possession, and that's half the battle! Should the Mavericks grab the first possession, Irving is our trigger man!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Hornets roll into Suns territory, and the first minute is all we care about! The jump ball goes Ighodaro against Diabate, and Ighodaro has the springs tonight! Win that tip and the Suns are first in line to score. If Ighodaro controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look!
